events.text:
T-228 is now in review with no new code. The welcome email is already the Registered campaign built under T-234, so building the Orchestrator's separate `enrolWelcome()` would have duplicated it.

I only checked the code and the T-234 log. I did not re-run any probe. That campaign is enrolled from admin add and `/cal/issue`, and the T-234 log records its probe passing 51/51 against vendor-sim. Live send evidence still needs the Tantra key, which T-337 tracks. Both feedback notes (F-c01987f5, R-001e64d4) are acked.
